import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=lambda *a: subprocess.check_output(['git',*a])
ids=[s.split()[2] for s in r('fsck','--no-reflogs','--unreachable').decode().splitlines() if s.startswith('unreachable blob')]
p=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
for oid in ids:
 p.stdin.write((oid+'\n').encode());p.stdin.flush()
 header=p.stdout.readline().split(); n=int(header[2]); data=p.stdout.read(n);p.stdout.read(1)
 if b'equipment_pane' in data and b'detail_pane' in data and b'func _refresh_grid' in data:
  Path('work/reviews/repo-recovery/'+oid+'.gd').write_bytes(data);print(oid,n)
p.stdin.close();p.wait()
